New on our blog: What it takes for a conversational agent to investigate a denied insurance claim.

When a claim is denied, someone usually has to call the insurer to find out why. A single call can take a medical biller anywhere from 10 minutes to an hour. Every payer has its own phone tree, and resolving the call means getting a representative to explain both what went wrong and how to fix it.

 Candid Health has been using ElevenAgents to make these calls. Using the speech and turn-taking models we build in-house, their team tuned the agents’ tone and pacing, down to when they pause. In a pilot of 12,860 calls, the agents found both the reason for the denial and the next step in 59% of cases. 

“We deliberately set a high bar for success because getting part of the answer doesn’t really help our billers. We needed the agents to handle the entire call, from understanding why a claim was denied to figuring out what to do next. The fact that they could do that in over half of cases, especially this early, exceeded our expectations.” - Doug Proctor , Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer at Candid Health
